note: Method: the IMSLP author categories were incomplete for several authors (missing from them: Bériot Opp. 9, 17, 37, 43, 75, 114, 123 and the Méthode Op. 102; Baillot Op. 2, the Méthode and L'art du violon; Mazas Méthode Op. 34; Léonard La Gymnastique du violoniste and Op. 47), so I also used IMSLP 'List of works by …' pages and title searches, BnF SRU catalogue records for edition data, and Dancla's own catalogue of works (Notes et souvenirs, 1893, https://archive.org/details/notesetsouvenir00dancgoog) as a primary source. Level evidence: RCM 2021 violin syllabus (étude lists and bibliography), Henle's preface to Dont Op. 35; no syllabus lists cover Alard, Léonard, Sauret, Bériot's other books or Dancla's mechanism books, so most new levels are estimates (see level_basis). Judgement calls: books IMSLP rates Easy and first-position-only books are in skipped as below floor; BnF-only records with unknown contents are in skipped rather than listed; Dancla Op. 84 is kept at L1 as borderline. The lead's guesses resolved: Léonard Op. 41 is 6 Solos faciles (no 'Le Violoniste' study book found; the study books are Opp. 21, 40, 46 and La Gymnastique du violoniste); Sauret Op. 32 is the Rapsodie russe; Dont Op. 36 is a variations piece and Op. 33 is one of the five Hefte merged into Op. 35; Dont Op. 55 is listed at low confidence. Not checked: Hofmeister XIX (403), HathiTrust (bot check), Google Books (quota), ASTA CAP lists (not found), Dont Opp. 49/55/60/61/62 beyond English Wikipedia and the IMSLP work list, Ysaÿe's Exercices et gammes (contents not seen). Vieuxtemps Opp. 16/48 and Dancla Op. 68 have published accompaniments (see existing_issues). Wieniawski is tagged Franco-Belgian (Paris-trained) although Polish. Overlaps with other files: Dont Op. 38 (german_b, same title; they give L3, I give L2), Baillot Op. 2 (franco_b, L6 vs my L5); german_b also lists Dont Op. 39 and Opp. 18/20, which I left in skipped (below floor / merged into Op. 35). BnF dates the Conservatoire Méthode 1802 (IMSLP 1793, brief 1803).
